title: ar says /ar/
parentNote: Today the r starts bossing the vowel about. On its own the a says the short sound in cat, but put an r straight after it and the pair say ar, as in car, star and farm. The slip to listen for is the short a hanging on, so car comes out cah and park comes out pack — say the pair yourself and let them hear it: cat, cart. back, bark. The other slip is sounding the two letters out one at a time, so farm comes out fa-rum; point at the ar as one chunk, exactly the way you did with ee and ue. Open your mouth wide, like at the dentist, and pull your tongue back: arrr. It is a satisfying noise and worth being silly with.

activities.title: The star on the farm
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: It is dark on the farm, and Mark can not sleep.
Mark got up and did sit on the barn steps.
Up in the dark is a star. It is big and sharp.
Then the star came in fast and did land in the grass!
Mark ran up. It is not a star.
It is a kite with a lamp on it.
Meg is up the hill with the string, and Meg did not spot Mark.
Mark did smile. Meg made a star on the farm!
